name: pr0gbarz
description: A focused, self-hosted project and progress tracker

scripts.backup: npm run prebuild && npm run build --workspace @pr0gbarz/api && npm run backup --workspace @pr0gbarz/api --
scripts.prebuild: npm run build --workspace @pr0gbarz/contracts && npm run build --workspace @pr0gbarz/database && npm run build --workspace @pr0gbarz/ui
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names database,api,web --prefix-colors yellow,blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @pr0gbarz/database" "npm run dev --workspace @pr0gbarz/api" "npm run dev --workspace @pr0gbarz/web"
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run release:check
